description: Effectiveness-NTU with fouling resistance correction: 1/U_fouled = 1/U_clean + Rf_air/eta_o + Rf_tube. Temperature-dependent property corrections via viscosity and Prandtl number ratios. Part-load LMTD correction via Nusselt-Re scaling.

unit.name: Generic Air-Cooled Finned-Tube Heat Exchanger (Cross-flow, one fluid unmixed)
unit.source: Incropera & DeWitt (2006) ch.11; Kays & London (1984) Compact HX Design; TEMA Standards 10th ed.; Webb (1994) Principles of Enhanced HT

U_clean.note: Clean overall HTC referred to external (finned) area; typical air-water 40-80 W/m2K

eta_fin.note: Overall surface efficiency (eta_o), accounts for fin efficiency

Rf_tube_default.note: Tube-side (liquid) fouling resistance; TEMA treated water

Rf_air_default.note: Air-side fouling/particulate deposit resistance; TEMA industrial air

Re_ref.note: Reference Reynolds number at design flow rate

Pr_ref.note: Reference Prandtl number (liquid side at design temp)

mu_ref.note: Reference dynamic viscosity (liquid side at design, ~20degC water)

nusselt_exponent_Re.note: Nusselt ~ Re^n, n=0.6 for turbulent finned-tube (Dittus-Boelter modified)

fluid_properties.note: Temperature-dependent Prandtl/viscosity ratios used for property correction
